The fur is dark brown and shaggy, particularly around the head and shoulders. Short, curved horns are visible. The background consists of blurred trees and a blue sky.

The eye is visible and appears dark/black, though partially shadowed by fur.
No prominent ears are sticking out; the ear region is covered by the thick fur of the head, consistent with 'hidden in fur'.
